# Every VOLATILE function or procedure owned by a contrib or PL extension on PostgreSQL 17.6 (#331), one "extension function" per line.
# #258's pg17-volatile-functions.txt covers pg_catalog only, and extension functions live in the schema they were created in.
# Generated on a cluster with every extension in pg_available_extensions created (CASCADE), minus the third-party `vector`:
#   psql -AtF' ' -c "select distinct e.extname, p.proname from pg_proc p join pg_depend d on d.classid = 'pg_proc'::regclass and d.objid = p.oid and d.deptype = 'e' join pg_extension e on e.oid = d.refobjid where p.provolatile = 'v' and p.prokind in ('f','p') and e.extname <> 'vector' order by 1, 2"
# Regenerate on a major-version bump; test/sqlGuard-volatile-catalog-contrib.test.ts reads it.
